sectionsUsed: 2.1 Invoking the Interpreter: python3 on Unix; py on Windows
2.1.1 Argument Passing: the script name and additional arguments are turned into a list of strings assigned to sys.argv; sys.argv[0] is the script name
1.1.1 Interface options: python script.py executes the script; -c command; -m module
__name__ == '__main__': a module's __name__ is set to '__main__' when it is run as the top-level script, and to its module name when imported
Idiomatic usage: put code in a main() function and call sys.exit(main()); the return value becomes the exit status
6.1.1 Executing modules as scripts: the code in if __name__ == "__main__": runs only when the module is executed as the main file, not when imported
4.1 Python install manager: the py command launches Python on Windows; running a script with py hello.py
